name: obvious-fix-not-landed

openThread.title: Null check missing before dereference
openThread.description: `session.user` may be `null` when the session has expired. Dereferencing `session.user.id` without a guard throws `Cannot read properties of null`.
openThread.suggestedFix: Guard the access: `if (!session.user) { throw new UnauthorizedError(); }` before reading `session.user.id`.
